sourceFile: 15. MSU-L20S15-07 Report test TIP 868 new supplier improve NG weak solder 2025.04.01_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft cites real rows but misidentifies the primary changed factor and builds invalid comparisons.
issues: Primary changed factor should be new vendor/test TIP 868 vs normal TIP 868, not before vs after repair.
Vision pairs cross different line/date/type groups and mix repair status with tip condition.
Subgroup keys omit date, line, repair status, test round, and A/B tension distinguish.
Function, tension, and drop outcomes are relevant but not correctly grouped under the tip validation.
Several measurement aggregates are header-derived and not valid outcome evidence.
correctionPlan: Rename changed factor to test/new-vendor TIP 868 versus normal TIP 868.
Rebuild vision outcomes using matched date, line, tip condition, and repair-status rows only.
Treat before/after repair as subgroup or secondary condition, not the tested change.
Regroup function, tension, and drop results by date, line, test round, and A/B distinguish.
Remove header-only aggregate measurements and cite actual result rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations exist, but they are insufficient because key rows are mispaired and some cited metrics are header aggregates.
